nodes.label:
Board Seat
Vacant
nodes.title: Board Seat Vacant
nodes.info: A seat with no current holder, either because the club is forming its first board or a term has just expired.

nodes.label:
Recruit for
the Seat
nodes.title: Board Member Recruitment
nodes.info: The deliberate search for people to fill open board seats based on the specific skills a seat requires -- financial literacy for a treasurer, public communication for a chair.

nodes.label:
Assign Roles
and Duties
nodes.title: Board Roles and Duties
nodes.info: The specific written responsibilities assigned to each seat, spelled out clearly enough that a new person stepping into a seat knows exactly what is expected.

nodes.label:
Meet on a
Fixed Cadence
nodes.title: Board Meeting Cadence
nodes.info: The regular rhythm at which a board actually convenes -- commonly quarterly for routine business plus one annual planning retreat -- set deliberately rather than left to chance.

nodes.label:
Term Limit
Reached?
nodes.title: Board Term Limits
nodes.info: Term limits cap how long any one person may occupy a seat before rotating off -- commonly two or three years, often renewable once -- guaranteeing new people and fresh judgement.

nodes.label:
Seat Rotates Off
(Staggered)
nodes.title: Seat Rotates Off (Staggered)
nodes.info: The seat vacates on its own staggered schedule, never at the same time as every other seat. Staggering is what stops a board losing all its experience in one year.

nodes.label:
Founder or Lead
Mentor Departs
nodes.title: Founder or Lead Mentor Departs
nodes.info: An unplanned or planned departure -- the event succession planning exists to prepare for. This is not part of the routine cycle.

nodes.label:
Execute Written
Succession Plan
nodes.title: Succession Planning
nodes.info: The board's written answer, prepared before it is needed, to the question 'who leads this club the day the founder cannot' -- naming an acting lead mentor and listing which signing authorities transfer.

nodes.label:
Acting Lead Named,
Signing Authority Transfers
nodes.title: Acting Lead Named, Signing Authority Transfers
nodes.info: The board's prepared answer takes effect immediately, rather than being improvised under pressure.
